blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Regional labor confederation International Trade Union Confederation (ITUC)-Asia Pacific has urged the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) to reject groups it accuses of falsely claiming to represent Myanmar’s independent trade unions as Manila hosts a regional forum on migrant labor on Oct. 14 and Oct. 15.
